from pptx import Presentation

p=Path('/home/user/Desktop/134_2.pptx')

    print('slide', si, 'size', prs.slide_width, prs.slide_height)

        text=''

        print(i, sh.shape_type, getattr(sh,'name',''), 'left', sh.left, 'top', sh.top, 'w', sh.width, 'h', sh.height, 'text=', repr(text[:100]))
PY"
